# The Title V

> Two individual one-bedroom apartments and an option to book both adjacent apartments at The Title V residence in Rawai, Phuket, Thailand. A local agent meets and greets guests.

## Apartments
- [Title V New & Bright 1BR at Rawai Beach](https://the-title-v.github.io/stays/bright-1br-rawai-beach/): maximum 2 adults + 2 children (up to 14), 1 bedroom(s), 1 bathroom(s), 37 square metres. A separate bedroom, a sunlit living room, and your own balcony. Settle into an easy Rawai routine, with the pools just downstairs.
  Public Airbnb source: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/622135535519576635
- [Title V New & Cozy 1BR at Rawai Beach](https://the-title-v.github.io/stays/cozy-1br-rawai-beach/): maximum 2 adults + 2 children (up to 14), 1 bedroom(s), 1 bathroom(s), 37 square metres. Warm interiors, a garden-facing balcony, and a separate queen bedroom. A comfortable base for beach days, quiet evenings, and longer stays.
  Public Airbnb source: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/922904332708842126
- [Two Adjacent 1BR Apartments in Title V Rawai](https://the-title-v.github.io/stays/two-adjacent-apartments-title-v-rawai/): maximum 4 adults + 4 children (up to 14), 2 bedroom(s), 2 bathroom(s), 74 square metres. Book Bright and Cozy together: two adjacent apartments, two kitchens, two bathrooms, and the freedom to keep your own rhythm.
  Public Airbnb source: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/926800271304117606
Children must be aged 14 or under; guests aged 15+ count as adults. Each apartment has one queen bed and one sofa bed. Per-apartment capacity always applies, including when booking the pair.

## Booking and reference pricing
- [Availability and estimate calculator](https://the-title-v.github.io/book/): Airbnb calendar availability is indicative and may be delayed. An enquiry does not reserve dates.
- [Rates](https://the-title-v.github.io/rates/): Per-apartment reference THB/night: May–September 1,000; April and October 1,300; March and November 2,000; December–February 3,300. Base rate includes 2 guests per apartment, 4 for both. Each additional child beyond that count: THB300/night.
- Accommodation discounts: 10% for 7–27 nights; 20% from 28 nights; not cumulative. Extra-guest and cleaning fees are not discounted. Online estimates support 2–180 nights.
- Stay total includes discounted accommodation, extra-guest charges and cleaning: THB1,500 per apartment per stay; THB3,000 for both.
- Refundable deposit is separate: THB10,000 per booking up to 30 nights; THB20,000 for 31+ nights, also for the pair. Return arrangements and any documented deductions are agreed in writing.
- Metered utilities are separate from the stay estimate: water THB55/m³; electricity THB6/kWh.
- [Booking details](https://the-title-v.github.io/booking-terms/): Our booking team confirms availability, the final offer, payment and cancellation terms. No payment is taken here.
- [Contact](https://the-title-v.github.io/contact/): WhatsApp +7 913 909 8949. Guests choose whether to send a prepared request.

## Arrival and house rules
A local agent meets and greets guests and handles the apartment handover. Check-in from 15:00; check-out by 12:00, Phuket time. Early check-in or late check-out can be negotiated, subject to availability, and may cost extra. No pets. No smoking. Keep noise low, respect neighbours and follow all condominium rules.

## Residence and location
- [The residence](https://the-title-v.github.io/residence/): Shared pools, gardens, gym, sauna/steam room, coworking, children's facilities and parking.
- [Map and nearby places](https://the-title-v.github.io/location/): The Title V (Rawai-Phuket), 555 Wiset Road, Rawai, Phuket 83130. Use the Title V map pin; other phases have similar names.
The apartments are within the residence, near Rawai waterfront, not on the sand. Rawai is known for boats, seafood and island departures. Nai Harn and Ya Nui are separate swimming-beach outings, subject to local conditions. The two apartments have separate entrances; no internal connecting door is advertised.

## Local guides
- [Find your rhythm in Rawai](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/rawai-neighborhood-guide/): A waterfront of longtail boats, everyday cafés, and an easy base for exploring Phuket’s south. Here is how to make Rawai feel familiar.
- [Nai Harn, Ya Nui, and the Rawai waterfront](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/nai-harn-and-ya-nui-beaches/): Three nearby coastal settings with different personalities. Choose a full beach day, a smaller cove, or a walk beside the boats.
- [Make a longer stay feel like home](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/long-stays-in-rawai/): The practical details that matter once you stop living out of a suitcase: a real routine, a clear quote, and space for everyday life.
- [Work days, with room for island life](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/work-from-phuket/): Plan a comfortable place to work, check the connection you need, and give your day a beginning and an end.
- [An easier Rawai stay with children](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/phuket-with-children/): Start with the sleeping arrangement, keep beach days flexible, and make room for the routines that help everyone enjoy the trip.
- [Arriving in Rawai, without the rush](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/phuket-airport-to-rawai/): Plan the transfer around your arrival time, luggage, and group. Then make the final part of the journey simple.
- [Getting around southern Phuket](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/getting-around-south-phuket/): Choose transport for the day you have planned: a waterfront stroll, a coastal bus ride, or a car for a few places together.
- [Where to eat, get coffee and buy groceries](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/rawai-food-and-markets/): Start with Tops and Starbucks at Mixxmall, add a salad lunch at We Café, then choose a seafood dinner by the water.
- [A slow week in Rawai](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/a-slow-week-in-rawai/): An adaptable seven-day outline with a few good outings and plenty of time to enjoy the place you are staying.
- [An evening at Promthep Cape](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/promthep-cape-sunset/): Make a little room for the view at Phuket’s southern end, with a flexible plan for getting there and coming home.
- [When the island asks you to slow down](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/phuket-rainy-day-guide/): Keep a second kind of day in mind: a museum, an unhurried lunch, a useful errand, or time at home with the balcony doors in view.
- [Travel together, with a home each](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/two-apartments-for-family-and-friends/): Two adjacent apartments can make a shared trip feel easier: time together when you want it, and your own space at the end of the day.
- [A practical evening at Rawai Seafood Market](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/rawai-seafood-market/): Choose the seafood, agree the cooking, and enjoy dinner near Rawai Pier. Here is how to make the market visit straightforward.
- [A longtail day from Rawai](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/island-trips-from-rawai/): Bon Island and Coral Island are places to explore with a local boat operator. Build the day around the sea, your group and a clear return plan.
- [Find the right massage in Rawai](https://the-title-v.github.io/guides/rawai-massage-and-wellness/): Two local options with published menus, plus a few details that make booking the right treatment easier.
